name: dify-canvas
description: 通过本机已登录的 Chrome 读取、修改、发布并试运行 Dify 工作流画布草稿。写回默认先给 diff，带备份与自检，发布需单独确认。
description_en: Read, patch, publish and test-run Dify workflow canvas drafts through the user's signed-in Chrome. Patches are dry-run by default with backup and self-check; publishing needs separate confirmation.
